messages:
meera: heads up — saw weird provisional token mismatch on the console when a request rerouted mid-stream to a cheaper variant. route shows +20 provisional but final ledger shows only +3. @oliver any idea? :thinking:

oliver: ouch. can you paste the route id + a sample session id? is this a toolcall or plain streaming?

meera: route_id=route-42, session=ssn_0x9f, plain streaming with periodic reroute due to capacity pressure. attached logs:
```
router: session=ssn_0x9f -> hostA (model=redwood-13b-v1)
stream-chunk: session=ssn_0x9f, chunk_id=1, tokens=12, charged_provisional=true
router: fallback session=ssn_0x9f -> hostB (model=redwood-7b-quant)
stream-chunk: session=ssn_0x9f, chunk_id=2, tokens=8, charged_provisional=true
session-end: session=ssn_0x9f, finalize ledgers
ledger: session=ssn_0x9f -> final_charge=3
```

meera: console shows per-route breakdown: route-42 provisional +20, route-b-fallback provisional +8, but final only 3. folks are seeing spikes in provisional quotas :eyes:

kai: that sounds like provisional credits didn't get reconciled correctly after finalization. are we double-allocating when chunk ownership moves between routing planes? we tag tokens by route owner, not by session finalizer.

oliver: right. current model tags at emit-time with route_id. if a session hops, we keep earlier provisional entries until the finalize sweep. finalize currently overwrites with final token count but doesn't backfill per-route deltas in the UI.

kai: proposal: change telemetry to emit a per-chunk 'billing_id' + 'model_variant' so we can attribute per-chunk and also show 'finalized_by' session id. small schema:
```
chunk_telemetry {
  session_id: ssn_0x9f
  chunk_id: 2
  model_variant: redwood-7b-quant
  billing_id: bldg-123
  provisional_tokens: 8
}
```

meera: nice. console UX idea: show two columns 'Provisional per-route' and 'Finalized ledger' with hover to expand chunk list. also add an 'atomic_billing' rollout toggle for customers who want no provisional counting (charge only on finalize).

billing-bot: FYI provisional tokens are currently allowed for latency-sensitive dashboards. switching to atomic means customers lose immediate quota visibility until finalize. recommend opt-in only.

ops-bot: /ops annotate ssn_0x9f — I can run a script to tag sessions affected and push a note to the incident.

oliver: implementation question: do we mark provisional entries as 'tentative' and then emit a reversal event when finalize differs? or compute final diff and adjust route buckets? reversal events may cause transient negative numbers in UI.

meera: I prefer emitting a 'settlement' event with both original_provisional and settled_final fields so UI can animate the delta. avoids negatives.

kai: telemetry change: add 'settlement_id' and trace to existing span. we should tag sampling at 1% for high-volume routes.

meera: I'll open a small RFC and mock console mockups. tagging @oliver @kai to review. short-term: can ops run a query to explain the current discrepancy?

oliver: run this ad-hoc:
```
select session_id, sum(provisional_tokens) as prov, sum(final_tokens) as final from token_events where session_id='ssn_0x9f' group by session_id;
```

meera: ran it — shows prov=20 final=3. filed incident ticket INC-2024-451. I can put a short note in console release notes.

kai: +1. also let's add a dashboard alert if provisional>final by >50% for 1h to catch regressions.

meera: thanks. follow-ups: (1) RFC with telemetry fields (2) quick ops script to annotate affected sessions (3) console mock for settlement animation.

oliver: I'll prototype settlement event shape tonight. :coffee:

meera: awesome — thx everyone.
